newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc gains, nickel falls, others ranged.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc gains, nickel falls, others ranged.

text.p: Zinc prices extended gains while nickel suffered a setback on the local market, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in a narrow prices band.

Zinc lifted 50 rupees at 7,750 rupees per quintal amid a shortage of ready material while an uptrend in the world market helped local prices to consolidate gains. Zinc rose 50 rupees per quintal last week.

Meanwhile nickel dropped 200 rupees at 37,100 rupees per quintal as demand resistance capped gains while a setback in the world market prompted profit-taking. Tin was steady at 31,600 rupees per quintal after gaining 400 rupees last week.

Copper was quiet at 13,500 rupees, as was aluminium at 7,425 and lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal in limited physical activity, but the undercurrent was firm following the scattered inflow of imports and a firm tendency in the world market.
